title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Apply themselves to a profession as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and strength as innovators who can think and act for themselves. (2) Set goals for going on to graduate school or finding a job as a plan for their career.
advice: We will cover the following topics based on the student's self-analysis and career planning: 1. Self-analysis: Past and present, advantages and disadvantages 2. Practice exam: Synthetic Personality Inventory (SPI) Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class.
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminar I is a required course aimed at helping students going on to graduate school or finding jobs. Therefore, all students are resquired to attend regardless of own study continuation plans.

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider the relationship between career planning and life design
Be able to identify advantages and disadvantages in career development
Be able to assess your own knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification, as needed to determine a career plan
Be able to present your own career planning policies and goals

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
